meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Aapke budget ke andar **acne-prone skin** ke liye sabse practical choice usually **2% Salicylic Acid serum** hota hai, kyunki yeh pores unclog karta hai aur active pimples/blackheads par kaam karta hai.[4][6][7]

**Meri top picks (₹700 ke andar):**

- **Dot & Key Cica 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** — acne aur oily, sensitive skin ke liye target kiya gaya hai; listed price around **₹467** hai.[7]
- **Myupchar 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum** — acne, pimples aur open pores ke liye; price **₹539** dikhaaya gaya hai.[6]
- **Deconstruct Salicylic Acid Face Serum** — acne, blackheads aur open pores ke liye; sale price around **₹599.25** hai.[9]
- **The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide Face Serum** — acne marks/blemishes aur oil control ke liye budget option; NDTV list me **₹222** par diya gaya hai.[1]
- **Pilgrim 10% Niacinamide Face Serum** — acne marks aur brightening ke liye; NDTV list me **₹649** par diya gaya hai.[5]
- **Minimalist Alpha Arbutin 2% Serum** — zyada tar acne marks/post-acne pigmentation ke liye; NDTV list me **₹236** par diya gaya hai.[1]

**Seedha recommendation:**
- Agar **active acne + oily skin** hai, to **Salicylic Acid serum** lo.[4][6][7]
- Agar **pimples kam hain par acne marks zyada hain**, to **Niacinamide serum** better rahega.[1][5][17]

**Sabse balanced single buy:** **Dot & Key Cica 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** ya **Myupchar 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum** — dono budget me hain aur acne-focused hain.[6][7]

Agar aap chaho, main aapke **skin type** ke hisaab se 2–3 exact best picks short-list kar du: **oily, combination, ya sensitive**.
